incident-bot: INCIDENT DETECTED — Dedicated GPU pool (us-west-2) showing spike in 5xxs for v2-serving models, started 1714320950. Auto-created pager INC-2026-009 :rotating_light:

sophia: oncall (sophia) here, acknowledging. I see increased 502/504s and elevated queue times. Starting triage now.

mike: looking at node metrics — memory pressure on node gpud-12 is high, OOM killer traces around 1714320880. Not seeing full node churn yet.

raj: rolling CPU/GPU util for the pool: GPU p95 = 92%, kernel panic count = 0. Could be request-level load spike + bad batch size.

emily: customer support heads up: Hypatia Labs, MeridianHealth, and Quantix Payments reported errors in the last 10m. I can draft customer messages once we confirm impact window.

jordan: quick check — autoscaler has been at min replicas=6, max=20. Current replicas=6, queue backlog growing. Suggest scaling up and rejecting very large batched requests.

sophia: action plan: 1) scale pool to +4 replicas (mike) 2) apply temporary rate-limit profile for enterprise routes (raj) 3) prefix cache warm for top customers (jordan) 4) prepare statuspage + customer comm (emily). I'll own the incident until 1714323200 UTC or handoff.

mike: scaling now — API: `POST /infra/pools/us-west-2/scale {"delta":4}` — returning 202, scaling jobs started.

raj: implementing temporary route throttles for enterprise: set `enterprise.qps=0.6` and reject > 5s head requests. Patch applied to routing layer, propagating.

statusbot: Status update queued for publish: "Degraded performance for Dedicated GPU pool in us-west-2 affecting some enterprise requests. Engineers investigating."

emily: DRAFT statuspage update (please review):

"We are investigating elevated error rates for our Dedicated inference pool in US-West. Some enterprise customers may experience failed requests or increased latency. Our on-call team is actively scaling capacity and applying mitigations. Next update within 15 minutes or when we have a customer impact list."

sophia: approved with minor edit (add "Estimated affected timeframe: started ~1714320950 UTC").

emily: Customer-specific impact notes (initial):
- Hypatia Labs (account: hyp-201) — API failures for model inference causing degraded user-facing throughput. Likely 5-8% request error increase since 1714320900.
- MeridianHealth (acct: mdn-77) — background embedding jobs failing intermittently; retries are causing higher queue length.
- Quantix Payments (acct: qx-09) — transactional routing errors reported for some flows; engineering investigating potential tail-latency.

emily: Proposed customer notification snippet (tailored):

"Hi <Customer POC>, we are investigating degraded inference performance in our US-West Dedicated pool which may affect your account (ID: <acct-id>). Engineers are scaling capacity and applying temporary throttles to stabilize traffic. We will follow up within 30 minutes with an ETA and mitigation summary. If you need an immediate rollback to a private fallback, reply and we can coordinate."

sophia: Routing & contact map (do not publicize):
- Hypatia Labs -> Primary: leah@hypatia.com, Secondary: eng-lead@hypatia.com (cs: emily)
- MeridianHealth -> Primary: ops@meridianhealth.org, Secondary: darsh@meridianhealth.org (cs: emily)
- Quantix Payments -> Primary: pmo@quantix-pay.com, Escalation: security@quantix-pay.com (cs: jordan)

mike: telemetry snippet for postmortem — query to capture spike per-account:
```
sum by(customer_id) (increase(api_errors_total{pool=\"us-west-2\", code=~\"5..\"}[5m]))
```

raj: mitigation note: we rolled back a recent routing optimizer at 1714320800 that increased batch sizes for certain customers — that change may have amplified memory usage. Rolling rollback completed at 1714321150. Monitoring.

emily: sending targeted comms to Hypatia & Meridian now (cc: eng leads). Quantix on standby (waiting legal loop).

ops-rotation: please start preparing oncall handoff packet — include: timeline, scaling actions, customer contacts, alert queries, and statuspage link. Handoff scheduled at 1714323200.

jordan: initial results: after scaling + rollback of optimizer, 5xx rate dropped ~60% for common paths. Tail latency improving. Still seeing a small error delta for Quantix payment flows.

sophia: if we reach steady state for 10m, we'll transition to monitoring and postmortem mode. Otherwise escalate paging to SRE lead.

emily: final note — Customer-facing statuspage posted at 1714321220: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-009 — I've linked Hypatia & Meridian POCs privately.

statusbot: Incident INC-2026-009 status changed -> "Mitigating" at 1714321220 by sophia.

sophia: handing off to night oncall jordan at 1714323200 UTC. Handoff brief: scaled +4 replicas, rollback optimizer, enterprise throttle applied, customers notified, monitoring for 30m. Please escalate to raj if Quantix errors persist.

jordan: taking over. Acknowledged. I'll monitor Quantix flows and coordinate any further customer comms.

emily: Thanks team — I'll follow up with tailored post-incident comms and draft a short customer impact summary for account managers. :white_check_mark:
